newsitem.title: USA: Nevada Power files $125 million shelf.
newsitem.headline: Nevada Power files $125 million shelf.

text.p: Two business trusts formed by Nevada Power Co Tuesday filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $125 million in cumulative quarterly income preferred securities, series A.
The trusts, known as NVP Capital I and NVP Capital II, will use the proceeds from the offering to invest in junior subordinated deferrable interest debentures of Nevada Power Co.
The offering will be made through Goldman, Sachs & Co.

Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, which many include the purchase or redemption of one or more series of its preferred stock, capital expenditures, the reduction of short-term borrowings and working capital.
The five million preferred securites have a liquidation amount of $25 per preferred securities, the filing said.
The company, based in Las Vegas, is an operating public utility engaged in the electric utility business in the city of Las Vegas and vinicity in southern Nevada.
